'''The Borg''' is the 27th expansion of [[Star Trek CCG 1st Edition]]. It is published by [[Decipher]] on 19 September 2001. The set consists of 143 cards.

'''The Borg''' is the perfect companion set to the popular [[Voyager (expansion)|Voyager]] expansion. 143 cards include new [[:Category:Borg (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Borg]] personnel and ships, a new Hirogen affiliation, new cards for the [[:Category:Vidiian (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Vidiians]], [[:Category:Kazon (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Kazon]], Federation, and other affiliations, additional Delta Quadrant missions, and new dilemmas, objectives, and other cards to enhance the Voyager, full environment, and Warp Speed format decks.

The set is available in 11-card booster packs (6 common, 4 uncommon and 1 rare) with 30 booster packs in a box.

[[Decipher]] issued a double-sided Rules Supplement and Card List sheet inserted into each booster box.

This set is noted for the following:
*Introduced the Hirogen affiliation
*Included the official black border release of [[Seven of Nine (TD)|Seven of Nine]] white border promo first seen in [[The Dominion (expansion)|The Dominion]] expansion
*Included the Ultra-Rare Reginald Barclay found in 1:121 packs and another range of Rare+ cards (33% more rare than the normal Rare}
